name: Mei Shaonan Meng Gongchang - Endless
source:
The first attempt to reinstall Princess Maker series with boys as characters. You are allowed to choose background and a boy to nourish in the competition with other seven boys with tutors for the first prize of becoming the king.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
首次尝试以男孩为角色重新演绎《美少女梦工厂》系列。你可以选择背景并培养一个男孩，与其他七名男孩及其导师竞争，争夺成为国王的第一名。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
